note: Free index of this gateway's priced measures, served at GET /. Not submitted to https://402index.io/ -- this file is the source the GET / route serves, not a submission receipt (contrast base-chain-data-gateway's 402index-listing.json, which IS a submission receipt). The 402indexRegistration block below is the machine-readable form of that stance: it is what the capability market's offer projector reads to decide, and while withheld is true the projector never registers or looks these listings up on 402index.
status: provisional pricing, pending the hopeium business plan's re-pricing (2026-09-05-hopeium-capability-specification.md, section (vi))

402indexRegistration.reason: pricing is provisional pending the hopeium business plan's re-pricing; a public index listing would publish a price the plan is about to change. These offers still project to the house capability market and the house seller catalog, whose rows are the Group's own.

listings.title: Value-Chain Shares
listings.description: Each position's exact share of a farm-to-retail price ladder's retail price (producer's share first), the exact multiplier between adjacent positions, and the evidence label of every priced input row. Pure derivation over @red-cup-engineering/derive-value-chain-shares-service@0.1.0; every ratio is an exact reduced BigInt fraction, never a floating-point approximation.

listings.title: Territory Readout
listings.description: Every catalogued material whose row belongs to a requested place in the Turtle Island taxonomy or one of its ancestors, each with its known products and markets (citations intact), its currently held chain position, a holder rendered as the literal "not named" whenever the row carries no benefit-sharing record, and a notFound listing of every field the row itself marks unknown. Pure derivation over @red-cup-engineering/derive-territory-readout-service@0.1.0.
